practice_units.title: Types of Infrastructure
practice_units.problem: Classify the following into physical and social infrastructure: Roads, Hospitals, Schools, Ports, Telecommunications, Housing.
guidance: Physical infrastructure refers to structures like transport, power, and communication.
Social infrastructure refers to services like education, health, and housing that improve quality of life.
practice_units.solution: Physical: Roads, Ports, Telecommunications; Social: Hospitals, Schools, Housing.
